# spaceman xspace

Cross-space collaboration: peers, requests and settings.

Aliases: `cross-space`.

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman xspace peer`](#spaceman-xspace-peer) | What a space accepts from and may send to each peer space |
| [`spaceman xspace request`](#spaceman-xspace-request) | Cross-space requests: list, show, cancel and decline |
| [`spaceman xspace settings`](#spaceman-xspace-settings) | A space's cross-space settings |

## spaceman xspace peer

What a space accepts from and may send to each peer space.

Aliases: `peers`.

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman xspace peer delete`](#spaceman-xspace-peer-delete) | Remove a space's configuration for a peer |
| [`spaceman xspace peer get`](#spaceman-xspace-peer-get) | A space's configuration for one peer space |
| [`spaceman xspace peer list`](#spaceman-xspace-peer-list) | Peer configurations of a space (or of every space without --space) |
| [`spaceman xspace peer set`](#spaceman-xspace-peer-set) | Set what a space accepts from and may send to a peer (only the flags given change) |

## spaceman xspace peer delete

Remove a space's configuration for a peer.

```sh
spaceman xspace peer delete <peer-space> [flags]
```

API: `delete-xspace-peer` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |

## spaceman xspace peer list

Peer configurations of a space (or of every space without --space).

```sh

```

Aliases: `ls`.

API: `list-xspace-peers`, `list-all-xspace-peers` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE); without it, every space you can see |

## spaceman xspace peer set

Set what a space accepts from and may send to a peer (only the flags given change).

```sh
spaceman xspace peer set <peer-space> [flags]
```

API: `get-xspace-peer`, `put-xspace-peer` ([HTTP API](../api)).

Example:

```sh
spaceman xspace peer set --space payments billing --accept-questions --disclosure summary --send-questions
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--accept-delegation` | bool |  | accept delegated work from the peer |
| `--accept-knowledge` | bool |  | accept knowledge requests from the peer |
| `--accept-questions` | bool |  | accept questions from the peer |
| `--disclosure` | string |  | what replies disclose: none, summary or detailed |
| `--discover` | bool |  | let the peer's control discover this space |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--if-match` | string |  | expected object version (from an earlier read); default: the version read just before the change |
| `--kb` | string, repeatable |  | knowledge base the peer may ask (replaces the list) (repeatable or comma-separated) |
| `--max-pending` | integer |  | open requests from the peer at once |
| `--max-per-hour` | integer |  | requests from the peer per hour |
| `--send-delegation` | bool |  | let this space's control delegate work to the peer |
| `--send-knowledge` | bool |  | let this space's control ask the peer's knowledge bases |
| `--send-questions` | bool |  | let this space's control ask the peer questions |
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |

Edit a space's cross-space settings.

```sh

```

API: `get-xspace-settings`, `update-xspace-settings` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--if-match` | string |  | expected object version (from an earlier read); default: the version read just before the change |

| `--max-outgoing-per-hour` | integer |  | requests this space's control may send per hour |

| `--profile-file` | string |  | read --profile from a file (- reads standard input) |
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |
